description: You are a Regional Health Officer performing a quarterly data review. Log into DHIS2 (admin/district). Navigate to the Dashboard app and find existing dashboards containing health data (e.g., Antenatal Care, Immunization, Malaria). Select two DIFFERENT visualizations (charts, maps, or pivot tables) and add a substantive analytical interpretation to each one. Each interpretation must be at least 100 characters long and should meaningfully comment on the data trends or coverage figures shown (e.g., 'Coverage has dropped in Bo district compared to last quarter...').
